mechanism_name: 公共证据织网 / Civic Evidence Weave
mechanism_rule: A reversible spatial component is admitted only when one visible condition card, one paper-first service channel, one named human reviewer and one removal route are present together. The proposal records facility conditions and aggregate paper counts only; it does not infer people, rank participants or automate an operational decision.
spatial_feedback_cycle: human safety, access, rights and service review
retain, adjust, remove or return to research recommendation

tests.name: walking and wayfinding
tests.spatial_hypothesis: A paired static-paper and staffed route can preserve access when a digital prompt is unavailable or unsuitable.
tests.zero_period: Accessibility specialist and on-site staff record route continuity and paper-sign availability before activity; no person-level tracking is permitted.
tests.observation: signed walkover record, paper-sign completeness and unresolved route defect count
tests.human_decision: accessibility specialist and service lead jointly decide whether the route may open
tests.retain: continuous alternative route and paper fallback are recorded
tests.adjust: a non-critical sign or resting point is incomplete but a safe accessible alternative remains
tests.remove_or_pause: route continuity, emergency clearance or paper fallback is absent

tests.name: public inquiry and feedback
tests.spatial_hypothesis: A staffed counter and visible condition card make a public-service trial reviewable without requiring a personal device or a personal-data profile.
tests.zero_period: Named closure owner establishes a paper intake and a public closure-log format before an event.
tests.observation: aggregate paper intake count, closure status and service-desk availability
tests.human_decision: rights reviewer, community representative and service lead jointly review the public closure log
tests.retain: paper intake and named closure owner remain available throughout the published service period
tests.adjust: feedback reveals an operational barrier that can be corrected without changing the approved boundary of the trial
tests.remove_or_pause: no closure owner, unresolved rights issue or missing paper channel

tests.name: reversible component and maintenance
tests.spatial_hypothesis: A removable pavilion, shade edge or rain-garden interface can be maintained safely only when its clearance, upkeep role and removal route are checked as one condition.
tests.zero_period: Safety officer, maintenance representative and rights reviewer record component condition, clearance and removal responsibility before opening.
tests.observation: signed pre/during/post record, aggregate maintenance work-order status and visible clearance check
tests.human_decision: safety officer, maintenance representative and rights reviewer jointly decide retain, adjust or remove
tests.retain: all three records are complete and a named maintainer remains responsible
tests.adjust: a maintainable defect is recorded and the component can remain safe after a documented correction
tests.remove_or_pause: missing record, lost maintenance responsibility, failed clearance or safety defect

limitations: This matrix is a conceptual evaluation protocol, not a deployed AI system, a performance claim, a procurement specification, an approval, a completed accessibility assessment or an engineering method statement. Formal boundary, ownership, fire, road, station, drainage and maintenance information trigger a package-wide review and redraw.
